query: SELECT c.canonical_hash AS "creation_hash!: String", c.input AS "input!: String", r.request_id AS "request_id!: String", r.canonical_hash AS "canonical_hash!: String", r.request AS "request!: String", r.state AS "state!: String" FROM project_creation_inputs c JOIN fleet_outbox_requests r ON r.request_id = c.request_id WHERE c.request_id > ? AND json_extract(r.state, '$.kind') = 'decided' AND json_extract(r.state, '$.decision.kind') = 'accepted' ORDER BY c.request_id LIMIT ?
